title: Reactions
summary: Shows the reactions under a message as small pills with a count, lets the person add or remove their own with one tap, pick any emoji, and see who reacted.

key.description: The reaction key, usually one emoji.

count.description: How many people reacted with this key.

includesOwn.description: true when this account reacted with this key. The pill shows selected.

isSending.description: true while the own reaction is not sent yet.

name.description: Display name in this room, or bipe_app_you for this account.

pickerOpenFor.description: Row id of the message whose emoji picker is open.

sheet.description: The open who-reacted sheet for one key, newest first. Missing while closed.

error.description: true after a reaction failed to send. Shows bipe_app_reaction_failed once.

toggle.effect: Adds this account's reaction with that key, or removes it when it is there. The pill changes at once.

openPicker.effect: Opens the system emoji picker. A chosen emoji runs toggle.

openSenders.effect: Long press on a pill: opens the sheet with the people who reacted with that key.

notes: Quick reactions in message-actions: the 6 keys in this order: thumbs up, red heart, face with tears of joy, open mouth, crying face, folded hands. Then bipe_app_message_action_more_reactions opens the picker.
A reaction key is shown as sent. Keys longer than one grapheme are shown in full up to 16 characters, then cut.
bipe_app_reaction_label is the accessibility label of a pill: key, then the count already formatted.
Undecryptable, deleted and unsent own messages take no reactions. A failed own reaction goes away and sets error.
Reactions work the same in a DM and a group.
